run.input_snapshot: InfoLink internal, 2026-11-18: polysilicon N-type feedstock 42-43 CNY/kg (point 43); wafer 210RN 0.95-1.00 CNY/pc (point 0.975); cell 210RN 0.305-0.31 CNY/W (point 0.305); module TOPCon distributed-project delivery 0.68-0.76 CNY/W (point 0.72). Cost anchors frozen from model-library v1 run 2026-11-18: Mysteel cost model 2026-11-13 (polysilicon cash 34.3 / full 46.1 CNY/kg; wafer net loss 0.249-0.269 CNY/pc; cell net profit 0.010-0.013 CNY/W; module production cost 0.724 CNY/W); CPIA roadmap technical parameters (2025-2026 edition) unchanged; silver point estimate 11,500 CNY/kg (judgement) unchanged
run.assumptions: Electricity price judgement 0.30-0.45 CNY/kWh (point 0.375); silver point estimate 11,500 CNY/kg (judgement); silver-paste silver content 0.90 (judgement); paste processing fee 2,500 CNY/kg (judgement, range 2,000-3,000); module non-cash cost 0.045 CNY/W (judgement); all non-silicon / non-cell costs by residual method (derived_residual); module price calibre changed from the v1 overall average to the distributed-project delivery midpoint (calibre change registered)
